import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from offline_discovery.rule_generate import build_clusters
from test_cluster import brute_clusters
random.seed(99)
bad=0
for trial in range(200):
    fragments=[]
    for i in range(random.randint(0,20)):
        L=random.randint(2,4)
        cls=random.randint(0,2)
        alphabet=[1000,1400,1515,1600,1800,2000,3028,900,1200]
        vals=tuple(random.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(L))
        fragments.append((0,0,L,cls,vals))
    eps=(random.choice([0,1,300,1000,1000000]),random.choice([1,3,1000]))
    ratio=(random.choice([0,1,2,5]),random.choice([1,2,3]))
    got_c,got_n=build_clusters(fragments,eps,ratio)
    exp_c,exp_n=brute_clusters(fragments,eps,ratio)
    got=[{k:v for k,v in c.items() if k in ('id','class','members','core')} for c in got_c]
    if got!=exp_c or got_n!=exp_n:
        bad+=1; print('MISMATCH',eps,ratio); print(' got',got,got_n); print(' exp',exp_c,exp_n)
        if bad>=2: break
print('mixed-length trials done, bad =',bad)
